Serilog._comment: This host logs via Serilog (ReadFrom.Configuration), NOT the default 'Logging' provider. NOTE: SerilogExtensions.cs hardcodes MinimumLevel in C# AFTER reading this section (non-Development => Information), so the effective floor is Information regardless of the value below; the Override entries here still apply. Adjust SerilogExtensions.cs if you need a different production floor.

Cors._comment: Production origins allowed by 'YallaJoPolicy' (AllowCredentials for SignalR + Web frontend). Replace with the real deployed Web host origin(s). Wildcards are illegal with credentials.

ConnectionStrings._comment: SECRET — do not commit. Supply via the 'ConnectionStrings__DefaultConnection' environment variable / key vault. MUST include 'Encrypt=True' (startup guard rejects Production otherwise). Example: Server=...;Database=...;User Id=...;Password=...;Encrypt=True;MultipleActiveResultSets=True

Jwt._comment: SECRET — supply 'Jwt__Key' via environment variable / key vault (>=32 bytes).

Booking._comment: Force real DB-backed cross-module snapshot readers in Production (never the Development stub fallback), even if the environment name is ever misconfigured.

AzureTranslator._comment: SECRET — supply 'AzureTranslator__SubscriptionKey' via environment variable / key vault.

Gmail._comment: SECRET — supply 'Gmail__AppPassword' via environment variable / key vault. SenderEmail is non-secret config.

ExternalAuth._comment: SECRET — shared HMAC-SHA256 secret with the Web BFF (same SigningKey on both sides). Supply via 'ExternalAuth__SigningKey' environment variable / key vault — at least 32 bytes. Do NOT ship the dev key to production.

Recaptcha._comment: reCAPTCHA v3. SiteKey is public (client-side). SecretKey is server-only SECRET — supply via 'Recaptcha__SecretKey' environment variable. BypassForTesting MUST be false in production.

OpenTelemetry._comment: Set the OTLP collector endpoint for production traces/metrics (OpenTelemetry__OtlpEndpoint). Empty => exporter disabled.

Retention._comment: Auth disposable-state cleanup runs on the API host (single host). Keep Enabled=true here.

Weather._comment: WeatherAPI.com provider. To enable in production, set Provider='weatherapi' and supply ApiKey (SECRET) via 'Weather__ApiKey' environment variable. Defaults target the Free plan (100,000 calls/month, 3-day forecast cap).

ContentBlogs._comment: SECRET — HMAC-SHA256 key for content_blogs.BlogViews.ViewerHash. REQUIRED: the application refuses to start if missing/whitespace. Supply via 'ContentBlogs__ViewerHashSecret' environment variable / key vault.
